events.description: A yellow van is struck by a green car on its left side, causing it to lift and roll onto its right side.
A motorcycle crashes and slides on the road, ending up on its side with the rider dismounted and lying near it.
A police motorcycle collides with a silver sedan parked on the roadside, resulting in the motorcycle and rider being thrown to the ground and the motorcycle sustaining visible damage.
A motorcycle collides with a silver sedan, resulting in the rider being thrown and the motorcycle skidding and coming to rest against the car's rear bumper.
A black sedan is involved in a high-speed pursuit or collision sequence, seen swerving and driving erratically on a wet road; a red car is also shown damaged after an impact at the roadside.

events.description: A dark sedan (likely a Peugeot 309) is shown mid-collision, airborne and rotating after impact, viewed from the pursuing vehicle's windshield.
A red Mini Cooper collides with a black station wagon (Volkswagen Golf Variant), causing visible damage to both vehicles; the Mini’s front end is crumpled and the Golf’s rear bumper is displaced.
The aftermath of the collision: the silver Peugeot 309 (previously airborne) is now stopped with severe front-end damage, adjacent to the red Mini and black Golf; smoke/vapor rises from the Peugeot.
Close-up of the black Golf’s rear showing significant deformation and damage consistent with a rear-end collision.
A police motorcycle arrives at the accident scene; the officer is visible on the bike, approaching the damaged vehicles.
Two individuals engage in a physical fight on a wet street, involving punches and grappling near green trash bins; one person is thrown or falls backward during the struggle.

A red Mini Cooper collides with a large green wheeled trash bin, causing a violent splash of water and debris; the impact is clearly visible with the bin recoiling and water erupting from the front of the car.

Immediately after the car-bin collision, a person (likely the same individual from earlier) continues aggressive motion toward a phone booth, appearing to strike or smash it while splashing water; this constitutes a separate act of physical aggression against property and possibly a person inside.
A motorcyclist collides with a parked dark sedan, is thrown from the bike, and lands on the road; the motorcycle crashes into the front of the car.
